page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal numerals (I., II., 1., 2., 3.) stand in the right margin beside the lines. Running head at top centre-left, page number at top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Ex his iam manifestum fiet, quòd quæ mouetur, ab alio moueantur. Primùm ea quæ mouentur se-cundum partem & secundum accidens, ab alio mo-ueri, nemini est obscurum. Deinde de ijs quæ secun-dum se mouentur, si moueantur ui seu præter natu-ram, nulla est dubitatio, ea ab alio moueri: illa au-tem quæ natura mouentur, demonstrabimus simi-liter ab alio moueri.

Primò, quæ mouet seipsa, suntq; animata, ea moI.uentur ab alio, nempe ipsa anima, quæ est in illis quoddam internum principium, habens mouendi facultatem, & reuera mouens: sicut nauta solet mouere nauem.
Secundò, quæ mouentur secundum naturam, utII. grauia & leuia, non mouentur à seipsis, ac proinde ab alio moueri necessum est. Quod autem hæc non mouentur à seipsis, probatur.
Mouere seipsum, est habentium vitam, & pro-1.prie animalium. Atqui illa, grauia videlicet & leuia, non habent vitam, neq; etiam animā: igitur non mouentur à seipsis.
Quæ mouent seipsa, possunt etiam sibi esse cau-2.sa quietis: quod licet obseruare in omnibus animatis. Sed grauia & leuia non possunt sibi esse causa quietis: igitur neq; sunt sibi causa motus.
Nullum continuum mouet seipsum. Grauia & le-3.uia sunt continua: igitur non mouent seipsa.

page.notes: The marginal numerals I., II., 1., 2., 3. are read as printed; "I I." beside "ut" is read as II. The macron in "animā" is read as printed. Line-end hyphens in "natu-ram", "au-tem", "simi-liter", "mo-ueri", "se-cundum", "cau-sa", "le-uia" and "pro-prie" are printed and kept. The line-end "mo" in "solet mo / uere" shows no hyphen and is written whole as "mouere"; the split of "mouentur" at "ea mo / uentur" is likewise without a visible hyphen and is written whole, with the note placed at the break. The page number "151" is read from the top right and is not fully certain. The signature "k 4" and catchword "Quæ" are page furniture. Printed spelling "necessum est" and "seipsum" are kept as printed.
